nodes.languageNotes: Frontmatter-declared skill with progressive disclosure: what-to-do block for the core loop, supporting-info block for domain-awareness rules and in-session behaviors.

nodes.name: SKILL.md

nodes.languageNotes: Defines a multi-phase agent skill that coordinates three other skill docs (LANGUAGE.md, HTML-REPORT.md, INTERFACE-DESIGN.md) as referenced sub-resources.

nodes.name: LANGUAGE.md
nodes.summary: Shared architecture vocabulary for the skill, precisely defining module, interface, implementation, depth, shallow/deep, seam, adapter, leverage, and locality, plus key principles (deletion test, interface-as-test-surface, two-adapter real seam) and explicitly rejected framings.
nodes.languageNotes: Acts as the single source of truth for terminology; every other doc references it to avoid drift into terms like component/service/boundary.

nodes.name: HTML-REPORT.md

nodes.name: DEEPENING.md
nodes.summary: Playbook for safely deepening a cluster of shallow modules: classifies dependencies into four categories (in-process, local-substitutable, remote-but-owned ports & adapters, true-external mock), applies seam discipline, and specifies a testing strategy of replacing shallow-module tests with interface-level tests.
nodes.languageNotes: The dependency taxonomy drives the deepening recommendation shape and determines whether a port/adapter or direct interface-level testing is appropriate.

nodes.name: INTERFACE-DESIGN.md
nodes.summary: Design-it-twice protocol for exploring alternative interfaces for a chosen deepening candidate: frames the problem space, spawns 3+ parallel sub-radically-different sub-agents under distinct design constraints (minimize, maximize flexibility, optimize for common caller, ports & adapters), then presents and compares the designs with a recommendation.
nodes.languageNotes: Orchestrates parallel sub-agent generation and references both DEPENINGING.md dependency categories and LANGUAGE.md vocabulary to keep outputs consistent.

nodes.name: SKILL.md

Routes the user into one of two branches — a terminal-based logic prototype (LOGIC.md) or a multi-variant UI prototype (UI.md) — based on whether the underlying question is about state/business-logic or about visual design. Documents six shared rules (throwaway-by-default, one-command run, no persistence, no polish, surface the state, delete-or-absorb when done) and a handoff/capture step.

nodes.name: LOGIC.md
nodes.summary: Defines the logic-prototype branch: a tiny interactive TUI that drives a state model (reducer, state machine, or pure function set) by hand so the user feels out edge cases and data-shape questions. Prescribes a 7-step process — state the question, match the project's language, isolate logic behind a pure portable interface, build a single-screen TUI shell, wire a one-command runner, hand it over for the user to drive, and capture the answer. Emphasises keeping the TUI throwaway and the logic module portable, and lists anti-patterns such as tests, real databases, and mixing logic with terminal code.

nodes.name: UI.md
nodes.summary: Defines the UI-prototype branch: generate several structurally different UI variants on a single route, switchable via a URL search param and a floating bottom bar. Covers two sub-shapes — preferred adjustment to an existing page (A) versus a throwaway new page (B) — and a 6-step process: state the question and pick N variants, generate radically different variants, wire them with a switcher component, build the floating bar (with keyboard support and production gating), hand it over, and capture the answer before deleting losing variants. Anti-patterns include color-only variants, over-shared layout code, and wiring prototypes to real mutations.

nodes.name: android-dropdown-measure-offset-issue.md

nodes.name: harmony-and-android-file-viewer-patches.md

nodes.languageNotes: Explains HarmonyOS .har static-library repackaging flow where node_modules patches must be re-bundled into .ar files via a postinstall hook to take effect.

nodes.name: harmonyos_packaging_guide.md
nodes.summary: Illustrated guide to HarmonyOS HAP, HAR, and HSP packaging concepts and their build/runtime differences, covering single-HAP, multi-HAR, and multi-HSP architectures with a step-by-step HSP provider/consumer configuration walkthrough and cross-platform (Android/iOS) modularization guidance.
nodes.languageNotes: Distinguishes HAR (static, compiled into HAP like 'bricks in a container') from HSP (runtime-shared single-instance dynamic library) with concrete config examples.

nodes.name: react-native-css-interop-ref-loss-issue.md
nodes.summary: Investigation of FlatList/ScrollView imperative ref methods (e.g. scrollToOffset) failing after the React 19 upgrade, caused by react-native-css-interop wrapper intercepting component registration and conflicting with React 19's new ref-as-standard-prop mechanism.
nodes.languageNotes: Captures the conflict between css-interop's forwardRef-style props.ref patching and React 19's native ref prop convention.

nodes.name: react-native-safeareaview-deprecation-warning.md
nodes.summary: Diagnoses the recurring SafeAreaView deprecation console warning that fires even without business-code usage, tracing it to react-native-css-interop's startup cssInterop(SafeAreaView) registration accessing the deprecated getter, and documents the patch-package fix.
nodes.languageNotes: Warns that cssInterop global component registration can trigger deprecated framework getters as a side effect during library initialization.

nodes.name: rnoh-metro-css-interop-change-event-crash.md
nodes.summary: Resolves Metro bundler crashes (addedFiles / isSymlink undefined) triggered by file edits under RNOH + NativeWind, explaining how Metro 0.82+ expects a richer change-event payload than css-interop emits, with a patch-package fix and postinstall persistence.
nodes.languageNotes: Maps the Metro 0.82+ change-event contract (addedFiles/isSymlink) that the css-interop onChange handler was failing to provide, causing DependencyGraph/DeltaCalculator crashes.

nodes.name: rnoh-metro-initializecore-issue.md
nodes.summary: Investigates Android/iOS 'Property window does not exist' and Metro InitializeCore startup failures in RN 0.82 + RNOH 0.82, caused by Metro config merge dropping React Native's default runtime initializer modules, plus a later-added Metro-cache-induced WebSocket ReferenceError.
nodes.languageNotes: Highlights how custom Metro config merging can silently strip RN's default InitializeCore polyfill pipeline, breaking non-Harmony platforms while Harmony still boots.

nodes.name: rnoh-metro-no-apps-connected.md
nodes.summary: Fixes the 'No apps connected' Metro warning on HarmonyOS VMs: diagnoses the MetroJSBundleProvider pointing localhost at the VM itself instead of the host Mac, documents the adb-reverse/ohpm port-forward workaround, and covers Reactotron debug-port (9090) forwarding.
nodes.languageNotes: Clarifies the HarmonyOS VM localhost isolation problem where localhost inside the emulator refers to the emulator, not the Metro host machine.

nodes.name: rnoh-spinkit-compile-package-name-issue.md
nodes.summary: Resolves the Harmony ArkTS compile error where RNPackagesFactory.ets imports 'SpinKitPackage' from the RNOH spinkit module while the actual exported class is 'RNSpinKitPackage', documenting the import/instance rename fix.
nodes.languageNotes: Captures the naming gap between the RNPackagesFactory template's expected symbol and the RNOH-spinkit module's actual RNSprefixed export.

nodes.name: Podfile
nodes.summary: CocoaPods dependency specification for the SAMRApp iOS target; resolves React Native pods, adds react-native-splash-screen, and runs the RN post-install hook.

nodes.name: project.pbxproj
nodes.summary: Xcode project file defining the SAMRApp target's build phases, file references, framework links, resource copies (fonts, storyboard, xcassets), and build settings.
nodes.languageNotes: Large generated pbxproj (477 nonEmpty lines) enumerating every source/resource/framework member of the iOS target.

nodes.name: SAMRApp.xcscheme
nodes.summary: Shared Xcode scheme configuring build, test, run, profile, and archive actions for the SAMRApp target.

nodes.name: AppDelegate.swift
nodes.summary: iOS application entry point: wires up the React Native factory/delegate, creates the main window, starts React Native on the 'SAMRApp' module, and shows the splash screen; plus a custom delegate that resolves the JS bundle URL for debug/release.

nodes.name: AppDelegate
nodes.summary: UIApplication entry-point class that creates the UIWindow, instantiates the ReactNativeDelegate and RCTReactNativeFactory, starts React Native with module 'SAMRApp', and shows the splash screen.

nodes.name: application
nodes.summary: didFinishLaunchingWithOptions implementation that sets up the React Native delegate/factory, initializes the main window, launches the RN module, and displays the splash screen.

nodes.name: ReactNativeDelegate
nodes.summary: Custom RCTDefaultReactNativeFactoryDelegate subclass that overrides sourceURL/bundleURL to load the JS bundle from the Metro server in debug or from the packaged jsbundle in release.

nodes.name: LaunchScreen.storyboard
nodes.summary: iOS launch-screen storyboard rendering the 'SAMRApp' title and a 'Powered by React Native' footer, referenced by Info.plist as UILaunchStoryboardName.

nodes.name: PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy
nodes.summary: App Privacy manifest declaring accessed privacy API types (file timestamp, user defaults, system boot time) with their reason strings, no collected data, and tracking disabled.

nodes.name: jest.config.js
nodes.summary: Jest test-runner configuration selecting the 'react-native' preset for the project's JavaScript/TypeScript tests.

nodes.name: metro.config.js
nodes.summary: Metro bundler configuration merging the RN default config with RNOH harmony support, a @/ path alias to src, platform-aware InitializeCore selection, inline requires, and NativeWind CSS processing from global.css.
nodes.languageNotes: Wires AsyncLocalStorage to thread the active platform (ios/android/harmony) through Metro's resolver and serializer for per-platform module resolution.

nodes.name: nativewind-env.d.ts
nodes.summary: NativeWind-generated TypeScript ambient reference that pulls in the nativewind/typewind types for className/style support; committed as-is and not edited.

nodes.name: @react-native-ohos+elements+2.4.0-rc.1.patch
nodes.summary: Adds a Badge component (animated count/size text badge) to the @react-native-ohos/elements Harmony fork, including the JS implementation, its TypeScript declaration, and the index re-export.

nodes.name: @react-native-ohos+react-native-document-picker+9.3.2.patch
nodes.summary: Replaces the Harmony document-picker TurboModule ETS source with a rewritten implementation using the ArkUI file-picker/fileuri/fs/mime APIs, while preserving the canceled-error contract.

nodes.name: @react-native-ohos+react-native-file-viewer+2.3.0-beta.2.patch
nodes.summary: Rewrites the Harmony file-viewer TurboModule ETS source (adding a ResolvedFileTarget interface and updated open logic) and patches the prebuilt .har binary to match.

nodes.name: @react-native-ohos+react-native-fs+2.22.0-beta.3.patch
nodes.summary: Patches react-native-fs's normalizeFilePath to leave 'file://media/' paths untouched on Harmony, preventing premature scheme stripping of media URIs.

nodes.name: react-native-css-interop+0.1.24.patch
nodes.summary: Adapts react-native-css-interop to RN 0.82/Harmony: emits the new Metro >=0.82 {changes,rootDir} change-event shape from the CSS processor, and suppresses SafeAreaView cssInterop warnings while disabling ScrollView/FlatList/VirtualizedList className remapping.

nodes.name: react-native-document-picker+9.3.1.patch
nodes.summary: Adds Android New-Architecture codegen outputs for react-native-document-picker: a debug BuildConfig and the NativeDocumentPickerSpec TurboModule Java spec enabling Fabric/TurboModule interop.

nodes.name: react-native-spinkit+1.5.1.patch
nodes.summary: Migrates react-native-spinkit's Android Gradle buildscript and module repositories from the deprecated jcenter() to mavenCentral().

nodes.name: react-native.config.js
nodes.summary: React Native CLI configuration declaring native font assets (ant-design icon fonts) for automatic linking/bundling into the platform targets.

nodes.name: repack-ohos-hars.sh
nodes.summary: Build script that repacks the Harmony document-picker and file-viewer .har archives with their patched ETS sources so hvigor produces bytecode har files parseable at runtime.

nodes.name: repack_one
nodes.summary: Repackages a single .har: extracts it into a temp dir, overwrites the target ETS source file, strips macOS metadata, and re-tars the archive in place.

nodes.name: .gitkeep
nodes.summary: Empty placeholder preserving the src/ directory under version control before any source files are added.

nodes.name: .gitkeep
nodes.summary: Empty placeholder preserving the src/assets/fonts/ directory under version control.

nodes.name: .gitkeep
nodes.summary: Empty placeholder file preserving the src/assets/icons directory in version control until icon assets are added.

nodes.name: .gitkeep
nodes.summary: Empty placeholder file preserving the src/assets/images directory in version control until image assets are added.

nodes.name: FilterSlotPanel.tsx
nodes.summary: Horizontal filter slot panel rendering selectable filter chips plus reset/query action buttons for list filtering UIs.

nodes.name: FilterSlotPanel
nodes.summary: Renders a row of selectable filter chips with a down-arrow indicator, an optional reset-all button, and reset/query action buttons.

nodes.name: AutocompleteInput.tsx
nodes.summary: Forward-ref autocomplete text input that shows a portal dropdown with keyword-highlighted suggestions, debounced async loading, and imperative ref handles.

nodes.name: HighlightLabel
nodes.summary: Renders text with the matched keyword segment highlighted in a configurable color using case-insensitive index matching.

nodes.name: AutocompleteInputInner
nodes.summary: Core autocomplete input component managing input state, debounced data loading, dropdown visibility, layout measurement via Portal, and item selection callbacks.

nodes.name: types.tsx
nodes.summary: Shared type definitions for the InputAutocomplete component, including the item union, props interface, and imperative ref handle.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Horizontal marquee text component using react-native-reanimated to scroll text when it overflows its container.

nodes.name: MarqueeText
nodes.summary: Animates text horizontally with a repeating translate animation when measured text width exceeds container width, using reanimated shared values.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: App-wide constants including version, dev flag, platform identifiers, feature flags, and centralized storage key names.

nodes.name: asyncStorage.harmony.ts
nodes.summary: HarmonyOS platform entry that re-exports the default async-storage binding from the ohos compatibility package.

nodes.name: format.ts
nodes.summary: Pure formatting helpers for dates, relative time, currency, compact numbers, phone numbers, ID cards, strings, and file sizes.

nodes.name: formatDate
nodes.summary: Formats a date input into a localized zh-CN date string, returning a fallback for invalid dates.

nodes.name: formatDateTime
nodes.summary: Formats a date input into a zh-CN date plus HH:mm time string by composing formatDate with padded hours and minutes.

nodes.name: formatRelativeTime
nodes.summary: Returns a relative time label such as minutes/hours/days ago, falling back to a formatted date for older timestamps.

nodes.name: formatCurrency
nodes.summary: Formats a numeric amount into a currency string with thousands separators and configurable symbol/decimals.

nodes.name: truncate
nodes.summary: Truncates a string to a maximum length, appending an ellipsis when the string exceeds the limit.

nodes.name: formatFileSize
nodes.summary: Converts a byte count into a human-readable file size string in KB, MB, or GB.

nodes.name: modal.ts
nodes.summary: Promise-based modal helpers wrapping React Native Alert and the ant-design Toast for confirm, info, success, and failure dialogs.

nodes.name: useConfirm
nodes.summary: Shows a confirmation Alert dialog and resolves a boolean indicating whether the user confirmed or cancelled.

nodes.name: storage.ts
nodes.summary: Async storage facade currently backed by an in-memory Map driver, with a documented migration path to AsyncStorage for persistence.

nodes.name: tree.ts
nodes.summary: Tree data-structure utilities providing conversions between trees and flat lists plus lookup, traversal, map, filter, and parent-chain helpers.

nodes.name: tree2List
nodes.summary: Flattens a tree structure into a one-dimensional array by recursively visiting children.

nodes.name: list2Tree
nodes.summary: Builds a tree from a flat list by linking items to parents via configurable key/parentKey/children props.

nodes.name: getNodeByKey
nodes.summary: Recursively searches a tree for the first node matching a given key value.

nodes.name: getChildrenByKey
nodes.summary: Finds a node by key and returns its descendants as a flat list using getNodeByKey and tree2List.

nodes.name: forEachNode
nodes.summary: Depth-first traversal invoking a callback on every node in the tree.

nodes.name: mapNode
nodes.summary: Maps every node in a tree to a new structure via a callback, preserving the tree shape recursively.

nodes.name: filterTree
nodes.summary: Filters tree nodes by a predicate, collects matches, and rebuilds a pruned tree via list2Tree.

nodes.name: getParentNodes
nodes.summary: Walks from a node to the root, returning the chain of parent nodes by repeatedly resolving parent keys against a flattened list.

nodes.name: tailwind.config.js
nodes.summary: Tailwind/NativeWind configuration scanning app source files and applying the HarmonyOS nativewind preset.

layers.name: Feature Screens
layers.description: Top-level page components and feature screens (Home, MarketReg modules such as company/complaint/check/healthCertificate/instruction/medicalEquipment/medicine/textile/inspection/standardization, SmartReg, Me, and dev demos). Compose UI components, hooks, services, and navigation to deliver end-user flows.

layers.name: UI Components
layers.description: Reusable presentational and composite UI components shared across screens (DaDropdown picker suite, FilterListLayout, DetailSection, InfoDetails, checklist, autocomplete, upload cards, loading overlay, marquee, scroll-to-top FAB, complaint list renderers, etc.).

layers.name: Navigation
layers.description: App routing skeleton: root stack navigator, root stack screen registry with lazy screen registration, dev-demo stack, sub-stack header back button, and platform-specific navigation variants (iOS/Android/HarmonyOS).

layers.name: Hooks
layers.description: Shared cross-cutting React hooks that encapsulate reusable behavioral logic: usePaginatedList (data fetch/refresh/loadMore), useFilters, useTheme, useSelectBridge (cross-route selection), useListRefreshOnFocus, useScrollToTopFab.

layers.name: Services
layers.description: Network and API layer built on the axios apiClient: regulationService (~78 regulation endpoints), baseService (auth/upload/dict), dictService, menuService, smartRegService, userService, plus the core apiClient with logging, token injection, and typed errors.

layers.name: State Management
layers.description: Redux Toolkit store: store configuration, typed hooks (useAppDispatch/useAppSelector), and slices for user, ref-data, app, global loading, and menu state.

layers.name: Foundation
layers.description: Shared design tokens and platform-agnostic primitives: theme system (colors/spacing/typography via NativeWind), utilities (upload FormData builders, file download/preview, format, storage, tree, version), shared TypeScript types, app constants, native asyncStorage bridge, and asset placeholders.

layers.name: Native Platform
layers.description: Per-platform native projects and the patches that adapt React Native to each target: Android (Gradle/Manifest/Kotlin activities), iOS (Xcode/Podfile/Swift AppDelegate), HarmonyOS (RNOH hvigor/ETS entryability/CPP package factory), plus dependency patches for ohos/t_css_interop/document-picker/file-viewer/fs/spinkit.

layers.name: Build & Tooling
layers.description: JavaScript/React Native build toolchain and project configuration: package.json, tsconfig, babel/metro/webpack configs, jest, eslint/prettier/commitlint, husky git hooks, tailwind/nativewind config, scripts, and dotfile settings (.eslintignore, .gitattributes, .watchmanconfig, .bundle).

layers.name: Documentation
layers.description: Project docs and AI agent skills: README/CLAUDE.md, usage guides (API client, navigation, hooks, Redux, file upload, loading, list pages), RnOH integration docs, agent skill definitions (.agents/skills), issue tracker and triad docs, and HarmonyOS obfuscation rules.
